scientific_integrity: An explicit all-parameter proof is supplied. Finite exact-rational tests are corroborative, not a substitute for the proof. Prior-literature equivalence remains a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Equal-sized clique blades, one shared hub, ordinary ambient Euclidean metric; no classification of the complete optimal-center polytope beyond affine dimension.
title: Euclidean inballs of clique-windmill symmetric edge polytopes
